resources.string: Connect your Telegram account: Nuvio searches the chats and channels you joined for video files and lists them on the stream screen.
Log in with your phone number
Enter your phone number including the country code (e.g. +391234567890).
Enter the %1$d-digit code sent to your Telegram app.
Confirm the login from another Telegram device: %1$s
Telegram is not configured in this build (missing API ID / API hash).
Telegram is not available on this device (unsupported CPU architecture).

Nuvio connects to Telegram, with your account, to search the chats you joined for video files and stream them. Telegram is a trademark of Telegram FZ-LLC. Nuvio is not affiliated with or endorsed by Telegram.
The Telegram integration uses TDLib (Telegram Database Library) to log in, search messages and download files.
Licensed under the Boost Software License 1.0.

Complete the Telegram login from Nuvio on the paired phone: type the number, the code and the two-step password there, or approve it with the Telegram account already connected on the phone. Everything travels encrypted on your local network.
On the phone open Settings → Telegram → Telegram on the TV and follow the steps there.
Pair the phone first: open Settings → TV Remote on this TV and pair it with Nuvio on the phone.
Logs in to Telegram on the paired TV (%1$s) from this phone, through the TV remote connection on your local network.
The TV can not be reached. Open Nuvio on the TV and keep it on the same network.
Telegram is not available on the TV.
The TV is connected to Telegram as %1$s.
Telegram is connected on this phone as %1$s: approve the TV login with this account, no code needed.
Or log in with a phone number
